description: The Crypto Fear & Greed index, a free daily reading of crowd mood from volatility, momentum, social media and search trends, used to time BTC and ETH: buy extreme fear, avoid buying euphoria, buy fear only in an uptrend, or short greed in a downtrend.
name: Fear & Greed sentiment
selection: Selected: Sharpe of at least 1 and at least 15% a year before 2024-07-01. Survived: Sharpe of at least 0.5 and a profit from then on.
